messages:
anika: Quick question from runtime team: when runtime decides to failover from private -> dedicated -> hosted, should we respect tenant.manifest.pin_to_model and failover only to compatible model families? Or is cost/latency first?

ched: we currently route on capability compatibility (model size, seq_len) + tenant preference. but fallback sometimes picks hosted smaller-quantized variant which breaks client expectations.

lee: real world example: client pins to gptx-8k; hosted fallback picks gptx-2k-quant which truncates long contexts and breaks conversation continuity.

anika: so two orthogonal constraints: functional compatibility (semantic equivalence) vs non-functional (latency/cost). proposal: add a predicate ranking where functional compatibility has higher priority than latency when manifest.pin_to_model is true.

ched: agree, but need to express "compatibility" precisely. Suggest fields: spec.fallback.allowed_variants: ["same_family","smaller_seq_len_allowed","quantized_compatible"]. Defaults to ["same_family","quantized_compatible"].

lee: also need explicit tenant opt-out for strict pin: spec.fallback.strict: true -> only identical model version allowed, no hosted fallback.

anika: ops concern: strict pin increases outage blast radius for Private when capacity scarce. We should add quota-enforced fallthrough: if strict and no capacity for X minutes, we trigger interrupt to tenant owners instead of auto-fallback.

infra-bot: metric alert: 6185002225 - increased fallback_to_hosted where model_family!=pinned observed in private-prod-1.

ched: UX: ping tenant owner via controlplane notification if fallback happens due to capacity and spec.fallback.strict==true. Provide link to reserve dedicated capacity or accept hosted variant.

lee: implementational detail: runtime should attach routing_reason header to routed requests: "X-Routing-Reason: fallback(hosted)" plus "X-Model-Variant: gptx-2k-quant" for observability and auditing.

anika: add trace sampling when strict pin prevented fallback: controlplane.event.strict_pin_blocked with tenant_id and seq_len.

ched: rollout plan: 1) add manifest fields + validation 2) runtime honors spec.fallback.* in decision engine 3) controlplane notifications + metrics 4) docs + tenant migration guide.

lee: owners: ch ed runtime logic, anika controlplane notifications, i'll do docs + migration guide.

anika: timeline: aim for canary in 2 weeks. I'll draft manifest schema PR and open RFC link.

ched: noted. will prototype routing_reason header in runtime today.

lee: thanks, team. :rocket:
